speakers.text: I think the campus cafeteria should stay open later during exam week. Many students study in the library until evening, and there are few affordable food options nearby after seven.
Later hours would help, but keeping the entire cafeteria open may cost too much. A smaller counter with sandwiches, fruit, and drinks could be enough.
I agree with a limited service. We should first survey students to find out which evenings are busiest, then schedule staff only when demand is high.
